facts.value: The Career Service of Goethe University offers workshops every semester where students can work intensively on their interests, goals, individual strengths, and professional profiles.

The Career Service provides practical and workshop offerings to help students align their individual competencies with the application process and successfully take the first steps into the professional world.
Students can gain important professional key competencies through networking opportunities at the Career Service's formats.
The department of Economics offers an event series 'Bachelor meets Business' every winter semester to help students network with reputable business companies.
The annually published career planner provides guidance for the initial steps in students' professional careers.
The Career Service and its partners offer various workshops on application training every semester.
Students learn what to focus on when applying to the German and international job markets.
Students can have their application documents reviewed through the application check offered by the Career Service.
Students can improve their soft skills by participating in various workshops and events to enhance their presentation competencies and methodological knowledge.
